subject: Catalog entry: AMI visibility + marketplace listing copy (Acme)
messages:
From: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@acmeplatforms.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing + AMI visibility question

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Two quick items we need to lock before we can schedule the AWS listing go-live:

1) AMI visibility. Our security team needs confirmation on the seller account that will own the AMI (seller ID) and whether the AMI will be public in the marketplace or restricted to private offers. Can you confirm the seller ID and whether Redwood will push the AMI or if Acme should upload?

2) Listing copy + pricing footnote. We reviewed the draft you shared; we have a few edits to the product description and a required pricing footnote for procurement. I attached the AMI manifest and a short PO template for your ops team to review.

We'd like to target a soft go-live on 2026-12-06, but procurement needs the final listing copy and the AMI seller details by EOD 2026-11-24 to meet their internal timeline.

Can you confirm next steps and whether Kimberly should own the copy review?

Thanks —
Samantha Chen
Product Partnerships
Acme Platforms
(samantha.chen@acmeplatforms.com)

Attachments: acme_ami-manifest-20261121.pdf, acme_purchase_order_4287.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@acmeplatforms.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + AMI visibility question

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the clear timelines. Quick responses:

- AMI ownership: Redwood will host the AMI under our AWS seller account by default for managed listings; however we can also accept a seller-upload model for private offers. Kimberly / Aditya — can you confirm the seller ID we plan to use and whether we should request Acme to upload?

- Copy review: Kimberly is best to lead the product page copy and the procurement footnote — Im looping her in.

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberly to send a tracked copy with our recommended edits by EOD today.
- Aditya to confirm AMI seller ID and whether additional metadata (e.g., support contacts, entitlement tags) are required.
- Samantha to confirm PO timeline and any special procurement language to include.

If it helps, we can do a 30-minute call Monday morning to finalize.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Product Operations
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@acmeplatforms.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + AMI visibility question

Thanks, Samantha — looping in the copy and AMI ops decisions below (reply inline).

> Our security team needs confirmation on the seller account that will own the AMI (seller ID) and whether the AMI will be public in the marketplace or restricted to private offers.

Logan confirmed Redwood can host the AMI under our seller account for the public listing. If you prefer Acme-owned AMI (seller-upload) for private offers, we can support that but well need the AMI sharing manifest and an IAM access window. Aditya, please share the seller ID were going to use.

> We have a few edits to the product description and a required pricing footnote for procurement.

See proposed listing copy below (short-form hero + three bullets) and a pricing footnote option. I tracked changes in catalog-listing-copy-v2.md attached. Please review and approve or mark edits inline.

Suggested product page copy (for hero + bullets):
Hero: "Redwood Inference — low-latency, predictable LLM inference for production workloads. Deploy hosted, dedicated, or private capacity with transparent pricing and enterprise controls."
Bullets:
- "High-throughput serving runtime optimized for batching and KV caching to reduce token costs."
- "Unified API and rollout controls across hosted, dedicated, and VPC/private deployments for predictable SLOs."
- "Enterprise-ready security: VPC connectors, KMS integration, and audit logging for regulated workloads."

Pricing footnote (procurement):
"Pricing is based on consumption per inference unit. Additional enterprise features (reserved capacity, extended retention) are billed separately under an annual agreement. Contact redwood-sales@redwood.com for volume discounts and private offer pricing."

Action items:
- Samantha: confirm whether the AMI should be Redwood-hosted (default) or Acme-uploaded (private offer).
- Samantha: approve the attached catalog-listing-copy-v2.md (I can accept inline edits).
- Aditya: confirm seller ID and whether we need to add entitlement tags for private-offer mapping.

I can push the catalog copy to the AWS console once we have seller ID and final approval. If the team wants a quick sync today, Im free at 4pm PST.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Product Marketing Manager, Marketplace
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: catalog-listing-copy-v2.md

From: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@acmeplatforms.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + AMI visibility question

Kimberly — thanks for the edits, they look great and align with Procurements requirements. Quick confirmations:

- We prefer Redwood-hosted AMI for the public listing to simplify entitlement mapping. Please proceed with Redwood seller account.
- Copy approved with one tiny tweak (change "per inference unit" to "per-token equivalent" in the pricing footnote). I made the edit inline in the attached MD and re-attached a signed PO stub for your records.
- Procurement will issue a formal PO next week — PO stub attached for planning. DocuSign link will follow (I added the HubSpot deal id in the notes).

Were good to proceed. Kimberly/Aditya: please confirm seller ID and Ill route procurement for the final PO once DocuSign is received.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Samantha
Samantha Chen
Product Partnerships
Acme Platforms
samantha.chen@acmeplatforms.com

Attachments: catalog-listing-copy-v2.md (approved), acme_purchase_order_4287.pdf
